Public Meeting to Hear Applications Under Sections 17, 34 and 51 of The Planning Act
Public Meeting Report Gentle Density Four Dwelling Units on a Lot Proposed Zoning By-law Amendment - 2024-140
notes:
Cushla Matthews, Development Advisor, introduced the item. 
Katie Nasswetter, Program Manager, Policy Planning, explained the details of the proposed regulation changes.

The following delegates spoke:
Andrew Arklie spoke in support of the proposed changes. 
Annia Kycia expressed concern about the intensification of the population in certain neighbourhoods.
Dillon Fraser spoke in support of the increase in housing.
Philip Maher feels that the increase is too much and that it is not gentle. 
Dave Groen expressed concern about the lack of oversight that would occur should this pass.
Council recessed at 11:30
Council reconvened at 11:35
Lyle Mcnair requested that a maximum number of bedrooms per property be instated.


The following delegates did not speak:
Andy Donlan
Susan Ratcliffe
Paul Szymanski

motions.item_title: Statutory Public Meeting and Decision Report 35 and 41 Janefield Avenue Proposed ZBA File OZS23-013, 2024-127
motions.text: That the application from Van Harten Surveying Inc. on behalf of 27 Janefield Inc. for a Zoning By-law Amendment to change the zoning from the current “Residential Single Detached” (R.1B) Zone (1995 - 14864) and the “Low Density Residential” (RL.1) Zone (2023 - 20790) to the “ Specialized Residential Semi-Detached/Duplex ” (R.2-XX(H)) Zone, and a “Specialized Low Density Residential” (RL.1-XX(H)) Zones to permit the proposed semi-detached dwellings with site-specific provisions at 35-41 Janefield Avenue be received. That the application from Van Harten Surveying Inc. on behalf of 27 Janefield Inc. for a Zoning By-law Amendment to change the zoning from the current “Residential Single Detached” (R.1B) Zone (1995 - 14864) and the “Low Density Residential” (RL.1) Zone (2023 - 20790) to the “Specialized Residential Semi-Detached/Duplex ” (R.2-XX(H)) Zone, and a “Specialized Low Density Residential” (RL.1-XX(H)) Zones to permit the proposed semi-detached dwellings with site-specific provisions at 35-41 Janefield Avenue be approved in accordance with Attachments 4 and 5 of the Infrastructure, Development and Environment Report 2024-127, dated April 9, 2024.
